eligible_depth_rule.0-30: Reaches or exceeds 30 cm; capped at 30
eligible_depth_rule.0-50: Extends beyond 30 cm; capped at 50 or sampled bottom
eligible_depth_rule.0-100: Extends beyond 50 cm; capped at 100 or sampled bottom
eligible_depth_rule.total: All sampled depths; valid measurements required

coverage_rule: Continuous measured coverage; no gaps/overlaps beyond floating point tolerance
stock_method: Source layer stock allocated by depth overlap
total_definition: All continuous sampled material from recorded top to sampled bottom; not confirmed whole-soil-profile stock
